_comment: PREVENT_DAMAGE was buried in an APPLY_CONTINUOUS inside a plain STATIC, so the shield was never registered. It is already a one-shot replacement effect (CR 6.4.10) consumed by the next matching damage, which is exactly what 'the NEXT TIME your hero would be dealt {p} damage this turn' means -- it needs no continuous wrapper, only to run when the card is played. Its DURING_TURN and IN_COMBAT conditions were nested where nothing compiles them.
